Subject: Renewal proposal draft: EU onshore nodes + APAC standby pilot

Hannah / Marissa —

Attaching the draft SOW for Clearwave's renewal. High level: 12-month renewal term with a committed SKU top-up of 16 dedicated GPUs (NVIDIA H26x) in our EU onshore cluster, plus an APAC standby pool (burst capacity up to 8 GPUs) for Q4 pilot traffic. The ask from the account: onshore data residency for EU traffic, KMS integration with their EU KMS, and a cross-region failover plan that keeps PII in EU primary unless failover occurs.

Key commercial points in the draft SOW (see attachment SOW_Clearwave_EU_Onshore_v3.pdf):
- Committed monthly spend: $105k/month with a 10% uplift on token volume ceilings for burst months
- APAC standby: billed for reserved standby at 25% of dedicated SKU rate when unused; 100% usage when burst invoked
- SLA: 99.9% regional availability; cross-region failover SLA includes degraded latency allowance (up to +150ms p50)

Can you two confirm the engineering constraints (KV cache behavior during failover, encryption key access patterns) and whether we can accept the EU KMS requirement without a major infra change? If all looks good I want to share the SOW with Clearwave and get procurement terms (invoice to EU subsidiary) nailed.

Attachments: SOW_Clearwave_EU_Onshore_v3.pdf (PDF, 78KB)

Thanks,
Ben

Ben / team —

Thanks for the draft. Looping Claire and Marco from Clearwave for transparency. A few clarifying questions before we send to procurement/legal:

1) Data residency & KMS: We can integrate with an external EU KMS but need to confirm which KMS provider (customer-managed key material means we need clear IAM paths). Priyom — can you confirm the integration work required and any expected lead time?

2) Failover behavior: In the failover window, what exact keys/data would be exported to APAC? We need to make sure PII never leaves EU at-rest unless explicitly toggled by the customer and with documented audit trails.

3) Billing entity: Claire — you mentioned earlier Clearwave EU SARL as the invoicing entity. Can you confirm the legal name and VAT number so we can fold it into the SOW?

4) Timeline: we recommend a staged rollout: 
   - Week 0-4: Contract/T&C sign and procurement PO
   - Week 4-8: EU onshore node provisioning + KMS test
   - Week 8-12: APAC standby provisioning + dry-run failover test

If we can get Priyom's sign-off on the technical path and Claire confirms procurement details, Marissa can push the redlines to legal and we can aim for signature by end of month.

-Hannah

Subject: Re: Renewal proposal draft: EU onshore nodes + APAC standby pilot

Hannah / Ben / Claire —

Quick technical rundown and constraints (summary + action items):

- KMS integration: Azure Key Vault in EU-West is fine. We'll implement envelope encryption: Clearwave's CMK will wrap a Redwood-generated data key. This keeps key material in Azure and we only store wrapped keys — meets "no key export" requirement. Expected infra effort: 2-3 dev days + 1 infra change window for IAM roles.

- KV cache & failover: During failover we will warm a read-only prefix cache in APAC from snapshots; no full export of customer PII. Writes will be queued and replayed to EU on failback. Rollback criteria defined below.

- Latency: p50 within EU baseline unaffected; when failing over to APAC we estimate p50 +120-160ms depending on route. We'll include a traffic shaping step in the dry-run to limit impact.

- Run-of-show (dry-run failover):
   1) Prep: backup KV snapshot, audit tokens, and pre-warm read-only cache (Ops)
   2) Cut traffic: shift 10% -> 50% -> 100% over controlled 15-minute windows (Engineering & Clearwave Ops)
   3) Monitor: error rate, token loss, latency; abort if error rate > 0.5% sustained or data integrity checks fail
   4) Rollback: immediate traffic shift back to EU and replay queued writes; require <60 minutes to complete

I've attached the current network topology and a one-page runbook stub. Priyom

Attachments: network_topology.png (PNG, 420KB)

--
